newsitem.title: USA: Dames & Moore sees growth from acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Dames & Moore sees growth from acquisitions.

text.p: Dames & Moore Group said Thursday it expects future growth will be driven by recent and future acquisition.

"While our traditional consulting service continues to perform exceedingly well, we expect most future growth to result from recently completed and future acquisitions," said Chief Executive Officer Arthur Darrow.
Darrow said in a statement he was pleased that the company is continuing to realize the benefits of its acquisition strategy enacted over the last two years.
Earlier the professional services company reported third quarter earnings of $5,636,000 or $0.28 a share compared with $5,335,000 or $0.24 a share in the comparable year-ago period.

The company said the earnings increase was largely due to the additive effect of recently acquired companies. Net revenue for the third quarter was $114.7 million compared with $97.8 million for the comparable year-ago period.
